The logo: K1 with no turn at all

Holger, 27 Sep: try not to rotate it at all, and see if the starting point on the left can be the same. So the block at zero degrees, Card Games’ chord level and only the bowl bending it, the block still on the card’s centre line with Card Games 16 from the edge. Three rows for the two readings of the same starting point: the starts kept where K1 has them, the two starts at the same x, and half way. K1 is kept as it was. The keepers stay as they are. Every row has a number and a name (say “L2”). Each row: the logo at 64px, then the site’s bar at a desktop width with the logo 32px tall, and a phone with it 24px tall.

L K1 with no turn at all

Holger: try not to rotate it at all, and see if the starting point on the left can be the same. So the block at zero degrees: Card Games’ chord is level and only the bowl bends it, falling 11 degrees at the C and rising 11 at the s; the block still sits on the card’s centre line with Card Games 16 from the edge. Three rows for the two readings of the same starting point: the starts kept where K1 has them, on the card’s lean; the two starts at the same x, World of directly over Card Games; and half way between.
